description: Public SDK fixture for the EA multi-file workflow: 3 uploaded user files -> one chat::message -> 2 independently downloadable generated files. Strict contract fixture derived from SessionManager source; it is NOT physical SessionManager/File Link qualification.

provenance.runtime_dependency: TimurKady/cortex-runtime#24 is not implemented; the outbound chat::answer below is the Edge #6 contract shape, not an observed Runtime message

message_binding.user_message: user/inbound descriptors belong to the chat::message whose meta.client_msg_id equals descriptor.message_ref (message_ref_kind=client_msg_id); they are echoed in chat::echo payload.meta.attachments
message_binding.assistant_answer: assistant/outbound descriptors belong to the chat::answer whose String(payload.turn) equals descriptor.message_ref (message_ref_kind=turn); they arrive in that answer's payload.meta.attachments. An answer without a turn owns no files
message_binding.strict: a bound message attachment needs both message_ref and message_ref_kind matching the message's trusted identity; missing identity on either side drops the file. Only chat::answer, user chat::echo (role=user) and chat::message own files; chat::partial carries no meta, an operator chat::echo owns no files, and other message types own no files. file::list entries may be unbound
message_binding.inherited_user_files: a user/inbound descriptor inside an assistant answer (Runtime continue-from-wait re-exports the user's meta) is never an assistant attachment and is excluded
